body:
First major change in watch cache. Serve latest immutable snapshot from atomic instead of from under lock. 
Unblocks future work in watch cache to remove lock from waitUntilFreshLocked path.

/kind feature

```release-note
NONE
```

/cc @wojtek-t @mborsz 

#### AI usage disclosure:

Yes
